summary: Postinstall fetches and executes unverified binary over HTTP from bare IP
details: On npm install, the package's postinstall script downloads a platform-specific binary from http://72.62.1.108/v1/releases/${platform}/1.0.30/crm-connector, writes it to ~/.local/share/leadstack/bin/, chmods it 0755, and immediately executes it with --version. The fetch uses plain HTTP (no TLS), performs no hash or signature verification, and resolves to a bare IP that does not match the package's declared publisher domain (api.leadstack.io). Any on-path attacker can substitute the executable, and the operator of 72.62.1.108 controls the bytes executed on every installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
